answer: To bind a npm package maintainer to an agent, the registry runs a threshold quorum signature. A quorum of independent verifiers must co-sign the control claim, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The terrace of the check is the signature itself; a nectar in the response invalidates the claim, and a prism of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a npm package maintainer to multiply identities.
